title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in the Grand complex, former Tregu Elektrik!
description_en: We offer an apartment for sale in the area of the electrical market, in the "Grand" Complex. It is located on the 7th residential floor, a new complex with an elevator and well maintained. The typology of the apartment is 2+1+2. It is organized in: - Entrance corridor - living room together with the kitchen. - 2 bedrooms, - 2 bathrooms - 2 balconies. - Net area 110 m/2 - Gross area 120 m/2 - The property offers a complete furnishing and comfort. - The orientation of the apartment gives natural light throughout the day.
